name: oldhand
description: A tracker-agnostic development workflow with prior-art research, minimal implementation, and real end-to-end verification.

interface.longDescription: Understand the real flow, research prior art, implement the smallest safe change, and verify it end to end.
defaultPrompt: Use Oldhand for this ticket. Apply my changed requirements and assumptions, preserve the named non-goals, and prove each acceptance criterion end to end.
Use Oldhand without a ticket. Treat this prompt, supplied files, constraints, partial work, and requested proof as the complete source of truth.
Use Oldhand in plan-only mode. Reconcile the ticket with my newer context, state material assumptions, and do not edit until I approve the plan.
